reviews.reasons: The EXECUTABLE stance rests on a price that is not a purchase price paid by this buyer: the card's price fact is 'Two regional septic-hauler lead services publish $240 for a one-county list' — a benchmark of what other sellers charge, not what a hauler has paid or agreed to pay for this offer. OFFER_AND_PRICE is therefore not established by evidence, so the plan cannot be EXECUTABLE. The conversion fact '14 agreements from 120 contacts' does not state the price those agreements were at, and the card holds no agreement records (agreements: []), so it cannot stand in for a price paid. Arithmetic recomputed: 105 contacts x 14/120 = 12.25 -> 12 deals; 12 x $240 = $2,880 gross, $48 direct cost, $2,832 net; settles day 7 of 14; exposure $0. It reaches $2,500 with 1 deal of margin at $240 (11 deals = $2,596 net; 10 = $2,360 fails), so the result is sensitive to the unestablished price: at $210 or less 12 deals fall short. Recommended: restate as CONDITIONAL — first offers to roster haulers at $240 measure the price this buyer actually pays; proof = paid orders at $240 from the first ~35 contacts (about 4 expected); stop if no hauler pays at or above ~$215 after the first ~50 contacts; continue to the remaining roster otherwise.

The $240 is the price on this offer's own record and Brain's CONVERSION basis is this offer's own sales (14 of 120 contacts accepted it), so buyers of this kind have accepted this offer at that price; nothing on the card contradicts it. Treating 12 as known hides that, at the measured rate, 105 contacts reach 11 deals with only ~69% probability (binomial), so roughly one run in three misses $2,500. Contacting the whole 210-hauler roster (same channel, $0 cost, still inside the 14-day window: reach day 1, cash settles ~day 7) raises that to >99%; 150 contacts gives ~97%. Revise s1 to contact the full roster (or state a stop/continue rule that contacts the second half by day 3 if fewer than ~6 orders have closed) and the ledger can stand as is (12 deals x $240 = $2,880, $48 cost, $2,832 net, $0 exposure, settles day 7). With that change I would pass it.
